responsibilities.description: Keeps rink temperature readings in memory and limits the history to the 1000 most recent, dropping the oldest when the limit is passed.
responsibilities.name: Store temperature reading history

responsibilities.description: Returns the most recently recorded temperature reading, or undefined if no reading exists yet.
responsibilities.name: Provide latest temperature reading

responsibilities.description: Stores and returns the current warm-spell state, whether triggered or not. It hands out defensive copies so callers cannot change the stored state directly.
responsibilities.name: Persist warm spell state
